an4.167:1.1: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto yenāyasmā mahāmoggallāno tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahāmoggallānena saddhiṃ sammodi.
an4.167:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ etadavoca :
an4.167:2.8: imāsaṃ āvuso catassannaṃ paṭipadānaṃ katamaṃ te paṭipadaṃ āgamma āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti?
an4.167:3.3: dukkhāpaṭipadā dandhābhiññā, dukkhāpaṭipadā khippābhiññā, sukhāpaṭipadā dandhābhiññā, sukhāpaṭipadā khippābhiññā.
an4.167:3.5: imāsaṃ āvuso catunnaṃ paṭipadānaṃ yāyaṃ paṭipadā dukkhā khippābhiññā, imaṃ me paṭipadaṃ āgamma anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti.
